Today I had the opportunity to download the lollipop 5.1.1 update. This update has probably been around in the USA for a while but was just pushed to me OTA here in Canada. I have been running android 5.0 since it was released and it was plagued with issues that were not there on jelly bean.

Some of the issues that arose with Android 5.0 was overheating, crashes with apps and the launcher, along with an overall sluggishness to the phone.

It seems that these issues have been resolved in the 5.1.1 update. It has a more fluid experience when switching between apps and feels quicker. I can't comment on battery life because it hasn't even been 24 hours since I've gotten the update. However my first impressions on the update are positive and it's a nice breath of fresh air from android 5.0.

So if you have the chance to update from 5.0 I'd do it.
